apps.name: RadioSphere
apps.description: Radio, podcasts, lokale audio en nieuwsbulletins.
apps.changelog: RadioSphere 0.3.40 - Reduced unnecessary playback wakeups during live radio - Improved wake mode handling for downloaded podcasts - Improved Wi-Fi-only scheduling for automatic podcast downloads - Reduced unnecessary background checks when notifications are blocked - Existing playback, now-playing detection and app functionality remain unchanged

apps.name: VatRadar
apps.description: Live VATSIM-radar met vluchten, ATC, vliegvelden, routes en vliegtuigfoto's.
apps.changelog: VatRadar 1.0.0-rc3.4 Added full English language support Added language selection: System, Nederlands and English Automatically follows the device language when System is selected Improved international usability throughout the app Fixed a Compose build issue in the flight sharing function Various stability and interface improvements

apps.name: Esmarty
apps.description: Material You app voor het vinden en vergelijken van lokale prepaid-eSIMs.
apps.changelog: Esmarty 0.5.1 - Redesigned the interface to more closely match the promotional concept. - Added richer destination cards with built-in city and country artwork. - Added featured destinations to the Countries screen. - Improved country overview cards with clearer pricing and availability information. - Redesigned eSIM offer cards with destination imagery and a more premium layout. - Improved empty states for Favorites, Wallet, Compare and Trips. - Added a more consistent Esmarty color palette and Material You styling. - All existing Esmarty functionality has been retained. - Travel Assistant, Wallet, Compare, trip planning, device check and installation tools remain available

apps.name: WeatherMe
apps.description: Material You weer-app met verwachtingen, waarschuwingen, radar en weerdetails.
apps.changelog: WeatherMe 2.4.1 - Fixed the WeatherMe launcher icon on Android. - Improved adaptive icon scaling for launchers and Android app settings. - No changes to weather functionality, widgets, alerts or radar.
